shared_rule: Distinguish the kind/purpose identifying an alarm from an activity referred to as an event.
coexistence_rule: An alarm category and a separately expressed event can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Soccer practice is assigned either type within alarm requests; action intent alone cannot settle precedence.

shared_rule: Distinguish an alarm category or purpose from its timing expression.
coexistence_rule: Wake-up category and seven am can both be expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Do not infer a time merely from the existence of an alarm; time also includes offsets under its own definition.

shared_rule: Distinguish software access from a company or business identity in the expressed role.
coexistence_rule: A merchant and an ordering app can both be named.
unresolved_constraint: Netflix is an app in playback and a business in stock queries; dual-purpose mentions need an explicit precedence policy.

shared_rule: Distinguish software/service from physical equipment.
coexistence_rule: Netflix and a PS4 can serve different roles in one request.
unresolved_constraint: A brand can denote hardware or software; the name alone is insufficient.

shared_rule: Distinguish an access application from content format or media source under the dataset convention.
coexistence_rule: Separately expressed application and content kind can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Spotify receives both labels in related playback contexts; native media_type includes platforms, so strict exclusivity is unverified.

shared_rule: Distinguish a performer/music creator from the author of a referenced book.
coexistence_rule: Separate people or separate creative roles can be expressed together.
unresolved_constraint: No observed shared names does not prove mutually exclusive identities; narrator versus author still needs policy.

shared_rule: Distinguish an artist identity from a color attributed to an object.
coexistence_rule: An artist and a color may be mentioned separately.
unresolved_constraint: Pink has both meanings; spelling and capitalisation cannot determine the role.

shared_rule: Distinguish the creator/performer from the song being identified.
coexistence_rule: Creator and work title commonly coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Artist names can also be work titles; no complete precedence follows from name recognition alone.

shared_rule: Distinguish the book's author from the book title or identifying reference.
coexistence_rule: A title followed by its author supports both roles.
unresolved_constraint: Only four author source utterances support the card; no broad narrator policy is established.

shared_rule: Distinguish the particular book reference from its media kind or source.
coexistence_rule: Audiobook and its title can both be explicit.
unresolved_constraint: Media_type also covers named sources; source versus title needs context.

shared_rule: Distinguish the work as a book from the work as a film using expressed medium/context.
coexistence_rule: Separate books and films may be mentioned together.
unresolved_constraint: Adaptations share titles; isolated titles need evidence unavailable from the name alone.

shared_rule: Distinguish a referenced book from a referenced song.
coexistence_rule: Different works can be named in one request.
unresolved_constraint: A title can be shared across media; do not infer medium exclusively from world knowledge.

shared_rule: Distinguish an identified establishment from its business category.
coexistence_rule: Starbucks and coffee shop can both be expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Olive Garden is annotated as business_type in some examples; semantic name/category distinction does not reconstruct all native gold.

shared_rule: Distinguish a company/publisher from a specific game reference.
coexistence_rule: A publisher and a game can be separately named.
unresolved_constraint: A publisher may be annotated as a game in the prior type card; do not expand game semantics to fit every label.

shared_rule: Distinguish a producing organization from the podcast program it provides.
coexistence_rule: A producer and separately identified program can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: NYT may identify a program by its publisher; metonymic naming needs explicit policy.

shared_rule: Distinguish an organization identity from a sport or sports-event reference.
coexistence_rule: A sponsoring business and a sport can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Sport_type includes team-related references in only four learning sources; organization/team precedence is not resolved.

shared_rule: Distinguish an organization considered as a business from its role providing transportation.
coexistence_rule: A transport provider and a destination business can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Ola and Uber receive business labels in stock questions; provider identity alone cannot settle every mention.

shared_rule: Distinguish a commercial establishment category from an ordering/fulfillment mode.
coexistence_rule: Restaurant and carryout can both be present.
unresolved_constraint: Takeaway can also describe an establishment; do not classify by word alone.

shared_rule: Distinguish a venue category from a location or destination reference.
coexistence_rule: A taco truck and a city can be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Store/theaters vary across labels; category-as-location and native metonymy need review.

shared_rule: Distinguish a control magnitude/target level from a calendar expression.
coexistence_rule: An adjustment level and its calendar schedule can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Numerals alone cannot decide whether an expression is a level or date.

shared_rule: Distinguish a control magnitude/target level from a clock time or duration.
coexistence_rule: A desired level and adjustment timing can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Maximum need not be numeric; minutes describe time rather than amount unless the controlled quantity is explicitly defined otherwise.

shared_rule: Distinguish a coffee variety/characteristic from an operation used to prepare food.
coexistence_rule: A coffee style and a separately expressed preparation operation may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Filter/roast can be characteristics or processes; no hard lexical mapping is justified.

shared_rule: Distinguish a coffee-specific variety/characteristic from a beverage reference.
coexistence_rule: Different beverages or explicitly separate characteristics may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Coffee is also a drink; absence of dual annotation does not prove semantic exclusivity or completeness.

shared_rule: Distinguish a preparation operation from the food being prepared/discussed.
coexistence_rule: Roll and sushi or frying and french fries can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Generic cooking verbs are not consistently established as annotated; unmarked operations cannot automatically be false.

shared_rule: Distinguish a preparation operation from a material used in preparation.
coexistence_rule: Poach and egg or steam and rice can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Food-versus-ingredient precedence is independently unresolved; this rule does not certify every material label.

shared_rule: Distinguish a preparation operation from a supplied duration or clock expression.
coexistence_rule: A cooking method and a stated cooking duration may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Asking how long to boil activates a question but does not supply a duration value.

shared_rule: Distinguish a monetary denomination from a geographic reference.
coexistence_rule: A currency and a geographic location may be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Country names are used metonymically for currency in native data; surrounding monetary relation must be examined.

shared_rule: Distinguish calendar anchoring/period from a clock time, duration, or offset.
coexistence_rule: Tomorrow and six can support distinct types.
unresolved_constraint: Weekend and next few days receive both labels in similar contexts; unit size alone cannot settle native precedence.

shared_rule: Distinguish an expression quoted or queried for its meaning from food referred to as food.
coexistence_rule: Separate definition targets and food mentions may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Garam masala has both labels by role; semantic food identity does not automatically license food_type alongside definition_word.

shared_rule: Distinguish a definition/description target from a person reference.
coexistence_rule: Different targets and people can be mentioned together.
unresolved_constraint: Describe Joe is annotated definition_word; person/target overlap requires annotation convention rather than name matching.

shared_rule: Distinguish a word/concept under definition from a place used geographically.
coexistence_rule: A definition target and a separate geographic reference may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Home and Angel have both roles; same-span dual presence or priority remains unverified.

shared_rule: Distinguish equipment from a transport mode or vehicle category in context.
coexistence_rule: A GPS device and its car can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Vehicles are also physical devices; broad physical-object membership is insufficient for native device_type.

shared_rule: Distinguish equipment identity from a weather condition or weather-related practical criterion.
coexistence_rule: A device and a separate weather condition can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Umbrella may express weather advice in this ontology; object identity alone does not imply device_type.

shared_rule: Distinguish beverages from food/dish references under explicit preparation and consumption context.
coexistence_rule: A meal order can mention food and drink separately.
unresolved_constraint: Ingredients cross both categories; liquid form alone is not a complete annotation rule.

shared_rule: Distinguish an address identifying a mailbox from the person it refers to.
coexistence_rule: Toby and the stated address can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: An address local-part is not automatically an independently expressed person name.

shared_rule: Distinguish a mail-storage folder from an identified list/task collection.
coexistence_rule: A folder and a separate list can be mentioned together.
unresolved_constraint: Generic containers such as wallet appear in list_name; no exhaustive container hierarchy is established.

shared_rule: Distinguish an event/activity reference from a meal occasion/category.
coexistence_rule: A meeting and lunch can be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Lunch can itself be an event; native priority for a single meal-event expression remains unresolved.

shared_rule: Distinguish an event/screening from a film title in the expressed role.
coexistence_rule: A screening event and a separate film reference can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Logan in near-equivalent show-time questions receives either label; do not invent a semantic difference to justify it.

shared_rule: Distinguish an event as an activity/occurrence from the subject of requested news.
coexistence_rule: A scheduled activity and a separate news topic may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Election receives either type in update requests; event/topic overlap needs explicit precedence.

shared_rule: Distinguish an event identifier from a person reference.
coexistence_rule: Sam and party can be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: An event can be named Anna, and all can refer to events or recipients; reference role rather than surface form is required.

shared_rule: Distinguish a general event/activity from a sports category or sports-event reference.
coexistence_rule: Separate events and sports references can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Basketball game is both semantically an event and sport-related; four sports sources do not establish same-span precedence.

shared_rule: Distinguish a food/dish from the meal occasion at which it is served.
coexistence_rule: Sushi and dinner can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Meal names can denote dishes or events; same-word assignment needs context and explicit convention.

shared_rule: Distinguish food content from its ordering/fulfillment mode.
coexistence_rule: Pizza and delivery can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Takeout appears as food_type in 2525 and order_type elsewhere; do not equate all native assignments with semantic correctness.

shared_rule: Distinguish a particular game reference from a game category or medium.
coexistence_rule: A named game and its medium can be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Game_type has only one learning source, video; no complete genre/name boundary is established.

shared_rule: Distinguish recurrence from a clock time/duration/offset.
coexistence_rule: Weekly and one pm can both be present.
unresolved_constraint: Every hour may express both a period and recurrence; no automatic single-label precedence is established.

shared_rule: Distinguish a requested joke characteristic/topic from a news subject.
coexistence_rule: Separate humor and news requests may express both.
unresolved_constraint: The same topic can belong to both contexts; neither word identity nor a presumed single intent proves absence.

shared_rule: Distinguish a joke characteristic/topic from a person participating in the request.
coexistence_rule: Funny and recipient Sam coexist.
unresolved_constraint: A person's name used as joke topic may overlap both; explicit annotation precedence is needed.

shared_rule: Distinguish a general task/item collection from a music playlist reference.
coexistence_rule: Separate lists and playlists may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Both are collections; generic list wording needs contextual evidence, not automatic inheritance to both types.

shared_rule: Distinguish a media kind/source from an identified playlist collection.
coexistence_rule: A collection and separately expressed media format/source may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Native media_type includes platforms; playlist providers are not automatically playlist identifiers.

shared_rule: Distinguish a media kind/source from a radio station or tuning reference.
coexistence_rule: A station and separate media/source expression may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: BBC is a media source in news requests and a radio station in playback; same-brand precedence remains task-specific.

shared_rule: Distinguish content kind/source from a particular song reference.
coexistence_rule: Music as a kind and an identified song can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Native song_name includes ambiguous platform/collection-like expressions; do not let those redefine all source roles.

shared_rule: Distinguish a film identifier from a genre/rating/selection property.
coexistence_rule: A film and its descriptive criterion may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Only eight movie_type sources exist; not every adjective is a valid genre/property annotation.

shared_rule: Distinguish a film reference from a music album reference using medium and work role.
coexistence_rule: Separate works in both media may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: 2911 is music-context movie_name; the only album source is a theme-song reference. Both need adjudication, not an invented overlap rule.

shared_rule: Distinguish a film from a song referenced in context.
coexistence_rule: A song and the film containing it may both be mentioned.
unresolved_constraint: Shared titles require medium evidence; titles alone cannot settle membership.

shared_rule: Distinguish an album release from a curated playlist collection.
coexistence_rule: An album and a separately identified playlist can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: The sole album source does not reliably establish album semantics; native absence is not a verified negative.

shared_rule: Distinguish an album collection/release from an individual song.
coexistence_rule: A song can be identified together with its album.
unresolved_constraint: The only album annotation concerns a theme song, and some song labels name artists; source adjudication is required.

shared_rule: Distinguish a music selection/property expression from a stylistic genre.
coexistence_rule: Popular and hip hop or a rating and folk can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Genre is itself a descriptor semantically; generic property inheritance does not establish native dual labels.

shared_rule: Distinguish characteristics selecting content from an operation/mode controlling playback.
coexistence_rule: Recent songs and shuffle can be separately expressed.
unresolved_constraint: Without shuffle still mentions a setting; presence must not be confused with choosing to enable it.

shared_rule: Distinguish music style from a playlist identifier, including a descriptive title.
coexistence_rule: Separate genre and playlist references may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Electronic is assigned either label; whether a genre inside a playlist title counts separately needs a span/precedence policy.

shared_rule: Distinguish a music style from the station being selected.
coexistence_rule: Hip hop and Hot 97 coexist.
unresolved_constraint: A genre-named station is not automatically an independently expressed genre under the native convention.

shared_rule: Distinguish the subject of news from a person reference in the utterance.
coexistence_rule: Trump and immigration policy may occupy separate roles.
unresolved_constraint: Trump alone can be a topic or person in news-like contexts; world knowledge does not determine native priority.

shared_rule: Distinguish a news subject from a geographic reference.
coexistence_rule: Elections and France can be expressed separately.
unresolved_constraint: World in near-equivalent requests receives either type; topic/location overlap cannot be resolved by prepositions alone.

shared_rule: Distinguish a person from an information field/attribute about that person.
coexistence_rule: John and address can both be explicit.
unresolved_constraint: A name does not imply an expressed address/phone field, and a field need not have a stated value.

shared_rule: Distinguish an identifying personal reference from a social/kinship/occupational relation.
coexistence_rule: Uncle and John can both be present.
unresolved_constraint: A relational reference can identify a person semantically; same-span type inheritance is not automatically native policy.

shared_rule: Distinguish a contact/personal attribute from a person's relation or social role.
coexistence_rule: Sister and cellphone number can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Email can refer to a message or a contact field; the distinction must follow the local role rather than keyword presence.

shared_rule: Distinguish a geographic location from the time standard used for a clock reading.
coexistence_rule: A location and a separate time zone may coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Moscow can be a location or zone reference; CST/EST as place_name in 2229 needs adjudication, not automatic acceptance.

shared_rule: Distinguish location identity from a journey/ticket property or route qualifier.
coexistence_rule: Origin/destination and round-trip property can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: A route clause may contain a location inside the descriptor span; nested mention policy is not yet established.

shared_rule: Distinguish a playback operation from a property selecting a podcast episode.
coexistence_rule: Skip and next episode can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Next can describe an operation or episode choice; no keyword-only assignment is valid.

shared_rule: Distinguish the music collection from an individual track reference.
coexistence_rule: A track and its collection may both be expressed.
unresolved_constraint: 361 labels Google Play as playlist; service/collection interpretation is unresolved and cannot certify general precedence.

shared_rule: Distinguish an episode-selection property from the program identifier.
coexistence_rule: Next episode and Con Man coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Some names include topic/command fragments; source boundaries require review before semantic supervision.

shared_rule: Distinguish the provider organization from a particular service, route, or journey identifier.
coexistence_rule: A provider and separately identified service can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Brands can name both operator and service; zero observed coannotation does not imply exclusivity.

shared_rule: Distinguish the provider from the travel mode/vehicle category.
coexistence_rule: Uber and taxi coexist.
unresolved_constraint: A provider-only request does not prove a separate vehicle category expression.

shared_rule: Distinguish a journey/ticket property from a service/route identifier.
coexistence_rule: A named train service and a trip property can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Depart is annotated as descriptor while branded trains receive name labels; neither syntax nor proper-name recognition fully fixes the convention.

shared_rule: Distinguish journey/ticket qualifiers from the transport mode.
coexistence_rule: Return and train or berth seat and train coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Descriptor contains heterogeneous route and departure phrases; scope remains under review.

shared_rule: Distinguish a service/route/journey identifier from its mode or vehicle category.
coexistence_rule: Train and number five can coexist.
unresolved_constraint: Service-number expressions can include a vehicle word; nested or same-span policy needs explicit treatment.
